explanation:
I found no Mathlib lemma that says `b ^ p = 1 → IsPGroup p (Subgroup.zpowers b)`. I grepped for `IsPGroup` across Mathlib and read all of `GroupTheory/PGroup.lean`. No declaration there or elsewhere mentions `zpowers`, `closure` or `powers` together with `IsPGroup`.

The nearest tools are `IsPGroup.of_card_dvd_pow`, `IsPGroup.of_card`, `IsPGroup.of_exponent_dvd_pow` and `Nat.card_zpowers`. One could try `IsPGroup.of_card_dvd_pow (n := 1)` with `Nat.card_zpowers` and `orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hbp`. That combines several separate lemmas and an auxiliary divisibility fact, so it is not a one-declaration instantiation. I did not count it as a duplicate or special case. Also, `p` here is an arbitrary natural number, not necessarily prime.
